value.rationale: The motivation is the explicitly open sharp metric three-point p-amenability problem. This is a complete exact and equality-case classification for the positive cone in its smallest symmetric metric-tree test family, proving that every stem variation and positive-mass imbalance fails to improve the standard witness. This supplies a precise structural cutoff on a natural attempted route to the global bound, without claiming to settle the global open problem.
